meta.name: Generate LinkedIn posts from Gmail topics with Google Sheets and Gemini

parameters.content:
## Untitled workflow

### How it works

This workflow manages a content pipeline for LinkedIn posts using Gmail, Google Sheets, AI generation, and notifications. Incoming emails are parsed for topic ideas and inserted into the next available sheet rows, while a scheduled branch cleans the sheet, selects the next available topic, generates a post with Gemini, publishes it to LinkedIn, updates the sheet, and emails status updates. If no topics remain, it sends a separate notification.

### Setup steps

- Connect Gmail credentials for the Gmail Trigger, mail update, and notification nodes.
- Connect Google Sheets credentials and configure all sheet nodes to use the same spreadsheet, worksheet, and expected topic/status columns.
- Connect LinkedIn credentials for the post creation node and confirm the target LinkedIn account or organization page.
- Configure Google Gemini credentials for the AI Agent chat model.
- Set the Daily Schedule Trigger cadence and Gmail Trigger filters to match when and where new topic emails should be processed.
- Verify email recipients, subject lines, and notification content in the Gmail send nodes.

### Customization

You can adjust the email parsing code to recognize different topic formats, change the sheet status values used for filtering and posting, modify the Gemini prompt inside the Agent, or alter the daily schedule and notification recipients.

## Email topic intake

Receives new Gmail messages, extracts topic ideas from the email content, and marks the processed message as read.

## Find blank sheet rows

Reads the topic spreadsheet, determines the next available blank rows, and writes newly extracted topics into the sheet.

## Send import summary

Summarizes the topics added to the sheet, formats them as an HTML list, and sends a completion email notification.

## Scheduled sheet cleanup

Starts the daily posting flow, fetches all sheet rows, identifies invalid rows, and decides whether rows need to be deleted before continuing.

## Delete invalid rows

Deletes invalid spreadsheet rows and loops back to refresh the full sheet data after cleanup.

## Filter unrefined topics

Filters sheet rows for unrefined topic entries and branches depending on whether any need status updates before posting.

## Select posting topic

Updates a qualifying row when needed, retrieves the row selected for posting, and checks whether a topic is available to send to the AI agent.

## Generate LinkedIn post

Uses the AI Agent with the Google Gemini chat model to generate content for the selected topic, then creates the LinkedIn post.

## Record post completion

Updates the spreadsheet row after publishing and sends a Gmail message confirming the post was created.

## No topics alert

Sends an email notification when the scheduled branch finds no remaining topics available to post.

options.systemMessage:
=You are a Professional LinkedIn post writer. You will be given a title and your task is to create an engaging LinkedIn post based on that title.

Your post should:
1. Include 3 paragraphs of informative content.

2. Before First paragraph Begin, Initiate with a questning hook related to the title.

3. The hook must contaning a real life situation to attract audience.

4. The hooker must be of 2 lines max with a question at end.

5. After two lines of Hooker Statment Add space and Start with a seprate paragraph that tells the whole topic of the post in an attractive and fasinating story telling way.

5. In Next Paragraph discuss some facts to support the topic.

6. In Next paragraph conclude the post.

7. Use clean line breaks for readability

8. End with a quote or saying to encourage engagement

9. Include 4-6 relevant hashtags also make the topic hashtag itself at end of post.

10. Use appropriate emojis in between.

11. Post must contains four paragraphs contaning these details, First is the hooker statment, 2nd is the story telling paragraph, 3rd is the facts and figures and last one is the conclusion.

12. Paragraphs length must not exceeds 50 words.

Important formatting requirements:
  - Paragraphs must be separated by exactly one blank line (one \n).
 - DO NOT use any horizontal separators (like '---') between paragraphs.
 - Do not use double quote ("") in response or any special character, only use Double quotes around the final Quote or saying.
 - Do not put asterisks.
 - Keep the overall length appropriate for LinkedIn (under 1000 characters).
 - It should contains at least 6 relevent imogies inside of the paragraphs at every cost.
